caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed tree with a winding trunk and branching stems that extend outward and upward, filling much of the vertical rectangular space. The background is a light, beige color with a faint grid-like texture. The tree’s trunk is primarily light-colored with decorative patterns in pink, blue, and yellow. The branches hold an assortment of stylized flowers, leaves, and fruit-like shapes in a variety of bright colors including pink, red, blue, yellow, and green. Several types of flowers can be seen, including large, multi-petaled blooms in red and pink, as well as smaller blossoms in pink, yellow, and blue. There are yellow, round fruit-like objects scattered throughout the branches. Some of the branches end in curling tendrils. At least one blue bird is perched on the upper left branch, and another blue bird on the upper right branch, with both birds having stylized, simplified bodies and curved beaks. The base of the tree trunk is adorned with symmetrical decorative patterns in blue, green, and yellow, suggesting stylized roots or ground. There are also small pink buds and green leaves scattered along the branches, and a few additional smaller blue and pink design elements throughout the composition. The overall composition is balanced with an even distribution of colors and forms.
title: Crewel Embroidery
